Title: General availability: Move MySQL servers to new resource groups and subscriptions

Body.Content: Customers can now move existing Azure Database for MySQL servers to either a new subscription or a new resource group in the same subscription. This functionality provides customers with the flexibility to manage their MySQL resources by using different resource groups and subscriptions. Learn more about how to move servers by using the Azure portal, Azure CLI, and REST API.
